The gross proceeds from the issuance of the FT Shares will be used to incur eligible “Canadian exploration expenses” that qualify as “flow-through critical mineral mining expenditures”, as those terms are defined in the

The Company will renounce such qualifying expenditures in favour of eligible arm’s-length subscribers, with an effective date no later than December 31, 2026, in an aggregate amount equal to the gross proceeds raised under the Offering. The Company will incur, or be deemed to incur, the qualifying expenditures on or before December 31, 2027.

There is no minimum aggregate subscription amount required for the Offering to close. The Offering may close in one or more tranches. All securities issued pursuant to the Offering will be subject to a statutory hold period of four months and one day from the date of issuance, in accordance with applicable securities legislation and the policies of the CSE.

ABOUT NORTH AMERICAN NIOBIUM AND CRITICAL MINERALS CORP.

North American Niobium and Critical Minerals Corp. is a North American mineral exploration company focused on the acquisition and development of precious, base, and critical mineral assets. Its portfolio includes the Silver Lake property in British Columbia’s Omineca Mining Division and a district-scale land package covering 29,936 hectares in Quebec’s Grenville Province. The Quebec properties host rare earth element, niobium, and nickel-copper occurrences, expanding the Company’s footprint into critical minerals that are strategically important for energy and defense applications.
